messages:
Rina (PM): Quick async check on Q2 OKR milestone: integration for Search Compose (M-42). Please drop status: shipped / slipped / in-progress + one-line blocker and next step. Owners listed: Alex, Diego, Priya.
Alex (Eng): Backend API merged, feature-flag gated. DB migration still pending — need infra to run it. CI green locally.
CI Bot: CI pipeline succeeded for commit abc123 (build #432). :white_check_mark:
Priya (Infra): I can run the migration tonight in the prod-canary window. Scheduling if PR updated before 22:00 PT.
Diego (Runtime): Runtime patch exposed a perf regression for long sequences, so rollout is slipped. Root cause: attention mask edge case in kv cache. ETA hotfix + perf tests by Tue EOD. Tracking: https://redwood.internal/issue/2345
Rina (PM): Ok — Diego, do you own the fix and verification? Alex, can you hold the canary until we confirm?
Diego (Runtime): I'll own the fix and perf verification. Will post results in this thread when tests complete.
Alex (Eng): Yes, will hold the feature flag at canary.
Rina (PM): Sam — can you take the code review on Alex's migration PR? @Sam
Sam (Eng): Will review first thing tomorrow AM. Quick note — migration should add the column as nullable to avoid locks:
```
ALTER TABLE search_jobs ADD COLUMN processed_at TIMESTAMP NULL;
```
Confirming null default to prevent long locks during backfill.
Alex (Eng): Thanks, will update the PR and push a new commit tonight.
Priya (Infra): Migration window reserved at 23:45 PT if updated by 22:00. I will post the run log here.
Rina (PM): Short summary so we have an async record: Shipped: backend API merged (Alex) but DB migration pending. Slipped: runtime rollout (Diego) — fix by Tue EOD. Owners: Alex (migration + hold), Diego (fix + perf), Priya (run migration), Sam (code review). Next actions: Alex updates PR by 22:00 PT; Priya runs migration at 23:45 PT; Diego posts perf results and confirms when safe to unflag. I'll follow up EOD. :thumbsup:
